requested.title: VIDEO_WORKERS is not validated as a positive integer, silently producing a corrupt frame sequence or a single-threaded fallback
Route param indexed straight into an object literal: inherited Object.prototype members pass the 404 guard and crash the handler
/api/cookie casts request.json() without validation and writes it straight into Set-Cookie, 500ing on ordinary input
Server and client cookie halves use different encodings, so the demo's "SSR Read" and "Client Read" panels disagree
Published demo source omits the `markdown` serve option the demo depends on
Module-scoped SQLite store leaks a DB connection and a timer on every dev reload (no pinGlobal, and ownsStore=false blocks framework cleanup)
